concepts.def: Exclusive breastfeeding recommended for first 6 months; weaning starts around 6 months.
Higher protein and calcium per kg body weight than adults; iron-rich foods support growth.
Calcium needs peak; UK RNI 1000 mg/day for 11–18-year-old girls.
Increased folate (400 µg/day pre-conception), iron, and avoidance of unpasteurised cheese and pâté.
Lower energy needs but protein, vitamin D and B12 remain important; sarcopenia risk.
Increased carbohydrate for glycogen, protein for repair; hydration critical.

Principles of Nutrition — a core area of A-Level Food Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Principles of Nutrition brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.
